image_description: A vintage light blue 'Merry Christmas' typewriter sitting on a wooden surface. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the elongated space bar at the bottom center of the key layout. The typewriter has round white keys with black characters and a distinct retro aesthetic.
